comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
I believe so. It looks like this ship was part of the virtual pack "Lion of the North" for Japanese players:

gamecity.ne.jp/dol/service/vpack/index3.htm

It specifically came from Vasa Exchange Ticket in their case; since GAMA is not subscription based, and lacks such packs, this will probably be a bottle ship released in the future.
